home.heroTitle: Marah Touqan, Brand Identity and UI/UX Designer. 13+ years of designing worth showing.
home.heroAriaLabel: Marah Touqan showreel 2026. Press to pause or play
introParagraphs: You're here because something needs designing. Maybe it's a logo that's been side-eyed in 12 meetings. Maybe it's an app your users keep getting lost in. Maybe it's packaging that looks fine, but fine doesn't sell.

I've spent 13+ years untangling exactly these problems. The trick is, I listen before I open Illustrator. Your vision is the brief. My job is to translate it into something sharper, simpler, and impossible to scroll past, in Arabic, English, or both.
home.dragonTooltip: Other designers want a house. I want a dragon. Currently in the egg-shopping phase. Don't laugh, the plan's going great.
